note: Round 14 (2026-10-25): the operator: "we're missing progressive sounds for bigger creatures landing on the board". g.landing.<tier> (new) is the thud after a creature's voice, by its power: 3-4, 5-6, 7-9, 10+; under 3 it is still g.enter (Hits the table). A landing, not a fight: weight arriving on the table, growing from a heavy step to the ground shaking. The colour's creature voice plays first, so these carry no creature voices.
